titleEn: I Didn't Listen to the End

pages.text: Grandma Bear called Ppino. "Go to the shop and—"
"Bread? Got it!" Ppino was already out the door.
Ppino bought bread. Grandma shook her head.
"Flour, not bread." Ppino ran out again.
Ppino bought flour. "I asked for salt too."
Ppino ran out once more. Their legs trembled.
Three trips altogether. The sun was already sinking.
Grandma Bear sat Ppino on a chair. "Listen to the end, and one trip is enough."
The next day, Grandma called again. Ppino kept quiet and listened to the end.
Ppino bought everything in one trip. The sun was still above the roofs.
